shared_elements: relief animal figure (possible quadruped/bird) on a block
low relief carving on an upright slab
justification: A shows a dense, legible programme of stacked registers: a row of masks/animal heads at top, a band of zigzag or fringe, a quadruped in profile above a small squatting anthropomorph, a fan/frond motif and a long-necked bird below, all in low relief on an upright pillar; B shows tumbled blocks bearing at most a faint low-relief animal or curvilinear form, with no discernible multi-register scheme. The only real correspondence is the generic one of low-relief carving on a large upright/blocked stone with an apparent animal figure, which any tradition could produce independently, and B's content is too indistinct to support any specific match.
